entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The reunited plane where the five former shards now clash and mingle.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: The shard of Alara of angels, knights and sigils.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The shard of Alara of etherium-wielding mages.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The shard of Alara of necromancers and demons.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The shard of Alara of dragons and predators.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The shard of Alara of elves, nacatl and behemoths.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: The vortex formed by the merging shards that sends waves of raw mana through Alara.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: A Bant knight who speaks of a dead man whose body belongs to Bant and soul to the angels.

entities.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
entities.description: The Esper sphinx ruler who claims the soul is only as eternal as she says.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who claims birth and death are reversible.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who comments on barbarians and sangrite.

entities.name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
entities.description: A Jund warrior who says any sword will do when the wielder is strong.

entities.name: Ennor
entities.description: A vedalken mentalist whose death led to his etherium recipients being slain.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: An etherium-giver credited by a filigree angel for opening its eyes.

entities.name: Taani
entities.description: A berserker of Etlan who has seen death before but never anything as dreadful.

entities.name: Gernan
entities.description: A Dawnray archer who sees wisdom in rhoxes joining the savages of Jund.

entities.name: Mayael the Anima
entities.description: An elf leader of Naya who speaks of behemoths and a new breed of guardian.

entities.name: Broka
entities.description: A Naya drumhunter who jokes about a behemoth eating wizards.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A champion served by squires who seek no glory beyond serving her.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer who says etherium is limited but innovation is not.

entities.name: Sedris, the Traitor King
entities.description: A Grixis king who disdains the wary and imprudent.

entities.name: Jorshu of Clan Nel Toth
entities.description: A Jund figure who makes his garden from the damned.

entities.name: Hadran
entities.description: A Naya sunseeder who says the fiercest hope is kindled in darkness.

entities.name: Lisha of the Azure
entities.description: A leader who says a new world needs warriors who know chaos.

entities.name: Kaeda
entities.description: An aven scout who mistakes a sedan-chair rider for a leader.

entities.name: Ranalus
entities.description: A vedalken heretic who found enlightenment in the coatl's scales rather than etherium.

entities.name: Knight-Captain Wyhorn
entities.description: A knight-captain who recounts how Jharic returned changed from Grixis.

entities.name: Jharic
entities.description: A knight who returned from Grixis changed and destroyed foes with unholy glee.

entities.name: Aarsil the Blessed
entities.description: A speaker on leotau seeking deadly lands to die as they lived.

entities.name: Thraximundar
entities.description: A Grixis zombie whose name means he who paints the earth red.

entities.name: Jenara, Asura of War
entities.description: An asura who passes over wounded soldiers with her eyes on the foe.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A demon-dragon who rises over the battlefield, quickening the blood of demons and angels.

entities.name: Architects of Will
entities.description: A secret society of mages manipulating others' beliefs and opinions.

entities.name: Knight of New Alara
entities.description: A knight who embraces all of Alara over his former home of Bant.

events.summary: Rafiq says a dead man's body belongs to Bant and his soul probably to the angels.
events.quote: His body belongs to Bant now.

events.summary: An etherium abomination is given life by the etherium of a hundred slain Esperites.
events.quote: It was given life by the etherium of a hundred slain Esperites.

events.summary: Sharuum the Hegemon claims the soul is only as eternal as she says.
events.quote: The soul is only as eternal as I say it is.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas claims birth and death are both reversible.
events.quote: Birth and death are both reversible.

events.summary: The Maelstrom sends a wave of raw mana across a battlefield, carrying off the fighting and the fallen alike.
events.quote: The Maelstrom sent a wave of raw mana through the battlefield, carrying off the fighting and fallen alike.

events.summary: After Ennor's death and the reclaiming of his etherium, its recipients are found slain for four nights.
events.quote: For four nights following Ennor's death and the reclaiming of his etherium, its recipients were found slain, the etherium ripped from their bodies.

events.summary: Malfegor rises over the battlefield, quickening both demons and angels, who see a chance to end their ancient war.
events.quote: The blood of the demons quickened as their master rose over the battlefield.

events.summary: Taani recalls seeing death before but nothing as dreadful as what she witnessed.
events.quote: I've seen death before.

events.summary: Alarans commemorate a hellion's appearances with holidays like the Great Cataclysm and the Fall of Ilson Gate.
events.quote: Alarans commemorated its appearances with new holidays bearing names like the Great Cataclysm and the Fall of Ilson Gate.

events.summary: Gernan observes once-devout rhoxes taking up arms with the savages of Jund.
events.quote: In this new world, I have seen the once-devout rhoxes take up arms with the savages of Jund.

events.summary: Broka jokes that a spellbreaker behemoth ate a bunch of wizards.
events.quote: I think it just ate a bunch of wizards.

events.summary: A knight embraces all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant, though his former home calls him traitor.
events.quote: Let my former home call me traitor.

events.summary: Jharic returns from Grixis changed and destroys her foes with unholy glee.
events.quote: Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes.

events.summary: During the collision of the shards entire ways of life vanish without a trace.
events.quote: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

events.summary: Godtrackers find new pantheons of beast-gods beyond Naya's borders.
events.quote: Godtrackers found new pantheons of beast-gods beyond Naya's borders.

events.summary: Ranalus says he found in the coatl's scales the enlightenment he never found in etherium.
events.quote: The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales.

events.summary: Kaeda mistakes a sedan-chair rider for a leader of the dragon-worshippers.
events.quote: It must be their leader.

events.summary: Jenara passes over wounded soldiers, her eyes on the foe.
events.quote: But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.

events.summary: Tezzeret declares etherium limited but innovation not.
events.quote: Etherium is limited. Innovation is not.

events.summary: Sedris, the Traitor King, declares an end to wariness and prudence.
events.quote: Too wary to charge, too prudent to serve. Not anymore.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol notes that many fools' chests burst trying to contain sangrite.
events.quote: Sangrite is the dragon's beating heart.

events.summary: Knight-captains recruit Nayan falcons as couriers after many aven die scouting the fronts.
events.quote: So many aven had died scouting the distant fronts that the knight-captains recruited Nayan falcons as couriers.

relations.note: Speaks as an authority on Naya's behemoths and guardians.
relations.quote: Do not mistake a behemoth's assistance for subservience.

relations.note: He is of Clan Nel Toth of Jund.
relations.quote: From the damned I make my garden.
